Brand owners selling direct and wholesal.name: Apparel and consumer brand owners
Brand owners selling direct and wholesal.description: These companies design and market branded apparel, footwear and consumer goods, selling through wholesale partners, their own stores and websites. Their earnings depend on brand strength and pricing, and on contract manufacturers and import costs.

Online marketplaces.name: Online retailers and marketplaces
Online marketplaces.description: These companies sell goods online, either from their own stock or through third-party sellers, and earn from product margin, commissions and fulfilment or advertising fees. They differ from store chains in spending heavily on warehouses, delivery and technology.

extra.name: Niche specialty and category retailers
extra.description: Retailers focused on one product category such as pets, pool supplies, gifts, cannabis accessories or heating fuel, selling from their own stock through stores and online. Margin depends on category loyalty, recurring demand and private brands.

extra.name: Resale, rental and small digital commerce
extra.description: Companies earning from rental, second-hand trade, or small online and tech-led commerce models. Revenue comes from rental and subscription fees or from reselling used goods.

Apparel and consumer brand owners.name: Branded apparel and consumer goods makers
Apparel and consumer brand owners.description: These companies design, make through contract manufacturers and sell branded apparel, footwear and consumer products through wholesale partners and their own stores and websites. They earn mainly from selling finished products of their own, which sets them apart from retailers that resell others' goods.

Off-price and dollar stores.name: Off-price, dollar and discount store chains
Off-price and dollar stores.description: These store chains buy goods that others make, often opportunistically from brands, and resell them to shoppers at low prices. They earn from the margin on that stock, which depends on low store costs and, for dollar stores, shipping and labor costs and lower-income customers.

value_chain.layer: Branded apparel and consumer goods makers
value_chain.description: These companies design, make through contract manufacturers and sell branded apparel, footwear and consumer products through wholesale partners and their own stores and websites.
